acceptanceCriteria: An owner-accepted rule names the tag target (gated commit or notes commit) and how the checklist relates it to FULL_COMMIT.
script/release-checklist, RELEASE-RUNBOOK step 10 and release-artifact-integrity-v0 agree, with a test for the chosen shape.
The v0.7.0 and v0.8.0 tags are evaluated under the rule without moving either tag.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. RELEASE-RUNBOOK step 10 tags the release-notes commit (v0.7.0 on 678c1b1, v0.8.0 on 516439f), while script/release-checklist:143-148 PASSes the tag row only when refs/tags/vX.Y.Z^{commit} equals HEAD, the gated FULL_COMMIT. After tagging v0.8.0, `script/release-checklist --pre-promotion` in the release clone at 31d68b4 reports `FAIL tag ARTIFACT-RDY-V0-003 expected release tag points at another revision`; run from the notes commit it would instead lose the full-gate receipt for HEAD. The runbook, script and docs/specs/release-artifact-integrity-v0.md must agree on one tag target.

completion.reason: Delivered by PR #153 (BUILD-LOG 2026-09-24 V1-0223 entry). Criterion 1: owner-accepted decision 0380 names the release-notes commit as the one tag target; its only parent must be the gated HEAD and it may change only Markdown under docs/ including docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md. Criterion 2: script/release-checklist, RELEASE-RUNBOOK step 10 and ARTIFACT-RDY-V0-003 agree; script/release-checklist_test.sh covers a tag on HEAD, a valid notes commit, a notes commit without the notes file, a non-docs path and a tag one commit further on. Criterion 3: the checklist reports PASS tag for v0.7.0 from 41f2b68 and for v0.8.0 from 31d68b4; neither tag moved.

title: release-checklist: ARTIFACT-RDY-V0-003 requires the tag on the gated HEAD, but RELEASE-RUNBOOK step 10 tags the notes commit
